title: Samsung DW80M9 — Inspection code display
description: Review stored inspection codes (n2) — up to 7 codes in EEPROM.

steps.title: Inspection code display (n2)
steps.body: While AS displays: press Hi-Temp Wash to cycle n1→n2→n3…. In n2, press Normal (Eco) to loop C00→C10→… Heavy shows sub-codes. Hold operation button 7 s to clear all codes.
